newsitem.title: USA: Computer Integration names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Computer Integration names new CEO.

text.p: Computer Integration Corp said Thursday John Paget will join the company as president and chief executive officer and one of three directors added to the company's board as part of its previously reported sale of common stock to a series of private investors.
This increases the board to six members, the company said.
The other new directors are Michael Santry and Matthew Waller.

Paget replaces Samuel McElhaney, who has filled the positions on an interim basis since December 1996. He will continue to serve on the board and will consult with the company on strategic planning and development matters.
Santry is the chairman of Chartwell Group Inc, a private investment company. He is also the chairman of ATC Communications Inc.
Waller serves as the chief financial officer of ATC.
"The recent private placement transaction represents a real milestone for CIC," said Chairman Frank Zappala.

"In addition to bringing in a new CEO and three new directors ... we have used the $7.4 million in proceeds to reduce the outstanding balance on our revolving line of credit with our principal lender.
"Increased liquidity should allow CIC to expand its value-added service business and enable CIC to grow as a national computer reseller."
